title: The AI race is back on
slides: Which AI giant just shocked the industry?
OpenAI unveiled its next-generation model, codenamed 'Orion'.
It can now plan and execute multi-step tasks autonomously.
Developers must redesign workflows to integrate these agents.
Test one agent-based task today to stay competitive.
thread_text:
1. The AI giant just blinked

OpenAI's next-gen model, codenamed 'Orion', can plan and execute multi-step tasks without human input, per a recent announcement.

2. What Orion actually does

Unlike previous models that respond to single prompts, Orion autonomously chains actions to complete complex workflows from start to finish.

3. Workflows must change now

Developers can no longer design for turn-by-turn interactions—they must build systems that supervise and intervene in agent-driven processes.

4. The quiet disruption

This shift means many white-collar tasks previously considered safe from automation now fall within Orion's reach, from research to project management.

5. Test it this week

Pick one repetitive multi-step task you do daily and try automating it with an agent-based tool. If you haven't, start there.
